offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from made-to-order parts; design feedback and quoting support the product sale rather than being the main offering.

big_ticket.reason: Typical orders are small, frequent prototype and low-volume part runs quoted online, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from automated factories, software quoting and machines producing parts, not mainly staff time.

notes: Customer size mix is not stated on the website, so the large-customer answer is a judgment.
